notes.title: Left4Dead Inspired Gamemode
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Survivors,
[/h1]
[b]at the moment we are working on the Escape Mode and reworking some things.

For example, we reworked the Lobby Menu, as you can see the Chars have his own Cards this gave us the opportunity to add new Chars without changing the Lobby menu too much. We are also working on a new Skill system where you can Skill your Player separate and permanent outside of the round! (Don't forget all Chars in this game has his own Skills/Abilities)[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34752693/6b21125e7d03edee3c22c4dac11095ef44cc10c4.png[/img]

[b]also, we are working on the Escape Mode, this mode is inspired by Left4Dead but it will have our own touch, we hope you like it!
For this one, you need to team up because without your skills(abilities) you are nothing! so stay together and kill as many dinos you can![/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34752693/76fdb56f822f337354b6637622148dd674072357.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34752693/c99aa5a015a514ab87450b56e3e893393f07460c.jpg[/img]

[h1]
SEE YOU![/h1]
[h1]We are working on a DevLog video but this needs a bit more time because its a lot![/h1]

notes.title: COLLECTORS EDITION - PRE ORDER
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34752693/fdb93c4ae5c3defcf9ea9f32b0a847cbbaee32ef.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34752693/6bbd565348ddc5ee82a4a479be517a856a1afa4b.jpg[/img][/url]

Hey survivors,
we are proud to announce our first peak for the "golden founder collectors edition". It will contain a lot of awesome stuff, so if you are a fan of dinosaurs you will love it. Thanks to global warming we were able to get some frozen prehistoric water, which contains flesh-eating viruses. Another highlight will be our real raptor claw, that is almost 8 inches big and sharp as a knife. But of course we also have some digital stuff you didn't want to miss, so you will get a digital artbook and a golden rifle that will surprise you to hell.

Our golden founder collectors edition is limited to 25 pieces and will cost round about $199. So stay tuned if you are interested in more upcoming stuff

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34752693/fdb93c4ae5c3defcf9ea9f32b0a847cbbaee32ef.jpg[/img]

Pre-Order Now: [url=https://www.amazon.de/Aufblasbares-T-Rex-Dinosaurier-Kost%C3%BCm-Rubies-Jurassic-Erwachsene/dp/B00TO6E0T8/ref=sr_1_7?__mk_de_DE=%C3%85M%C3%85%C5%BD%C3%95%C3%91&crid=4W972OBVY8ZN&keywords=trex+kost%C3%BCm&qid=1554154841&s=gateway&sprefix=trex+kost%2Caps%2C151&sr=8-7]Pre-Order[/url] 

See you!
